summary: Materialise NV filed a Form 6-K press release disclosing weekly progress of its ongoing share buyback program originally announced October 30, 2025, with a mandate to repurchase up to EUR 30 million. The report covers May 4-8, 2026, detailing repurchase of 44,893 shares at average €4.67 per share for €209,653, via NASDAQ open market orders. Since program launch on January 26, 2026, it has bought 673,973 shares (1.1% outstanding) for €3,042,441. This is a routine buyback update with no special-situation event such as tender offer, going-private transaction, or capital return program initiation; it merely reports execution under previously announced authorization.
